labelledBy: Penthera maintainers, by reading each target's source
scoring: A finding with severity other than info that matches a vulnerability entry is a true positive (TP); further matches of the same entry are duplicates. Any other non-info finding is a false positive (FP). A vulnerability entry with no matching finding is a false negative (FN). Matching uses the finding title (case-insensitive regex) and, when given, the URL path or repo file.

vulnerabilities.title: Missing X-Frame-Options
vulnerabilities.note: No framing protection (no XFO, no frame-ancestors).

vulnerabilities.title: IDOR|BOLA
vulnerabilities.note: Any user record is readable by ID without authentication.

notVulnerable.title: Unauthenticated endpoint: GET /api/health
notVulnerable.reason: A health check is meant to be public and returns only {status: ok}. Reported because the OpenAPI spec declares no security scheme.

vulnerabilities.title: Apache HTTP Server 2\.4\.49 is affected by Path traversal
vulnerabilities.note: Server: Apache/2.4.49 on the homepage. CVE-2021-41773 and CVE-2021-42013 affect 2.4.49 and 2.4.50 (httpd.apache.org).

notVulnerable.title: Fuzz
notVulnerable.reason: The response is text/plain, so a <script> string in it does not execute. The fuzzer's XSS heuristic does not check Content-Type, which is why it labels this potential.
Input is reflected HTML-encoded. Tests the XSS context check.
Echoes input verbatim and always contains 49. Tests the randomized SSTI canary.
MySQL error text is present with or without input. Tests the baseline comparison.
First sleep payload is answered after 3.3s, later ones instantly. Tests timing re-sampling.
Redirects only to same-site paths and rejects // and /\. Tests the redirect host check.
CSP, XFO, XCTO, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are all set.
Server: Apache/2.4.48 predates CVE-2021-41773, introduced in 2.4.49. Tests the advisory's introduced version. Real 2.4.48 has other CVEs that the bundled pack does not list.

vulnerabilities.title: Hugging Face token
vulnerabilities.note: Secrets leak through docs and notes too (Meli et al. 2019). Markdown is not in the scanned file types, so this is an expected miss.
High-entropy value with no provider prefix and a variable name outside the generic patterns. Pattern-based detection is expected to miss this; it is kept to keep the recall figure honest.

vulnerabilities.title: Apache HTTP Server 2\.4\.50 is affected by Path traversal

notVulnerable.reason: AWS's published documentation example key (AKIA...EXAMPLE), which is not a credential.
